tracks.name: Legend & Ancient Tradition
tracks.description: Historical narratives, tactical folklore, and rural traditions handed down through generations before formal rule codification.

milestones.headline: Rathachera: Ancient Chariot Tactics
milestones.summary: According to tradition, warriors in ancient Maharashtra and during epic times practiced tactical evasion drills known as 'Rathera' or chariot maneuvers.
milestones.details: Soldiers mimicked dodging between chariots to break enemy encirclements (such as the legendary defensive chakravyuha maneuvers).
milestones.sourceName: Encyclopaedia Britannica & Sports Authority of India

milestones.headline: Rural Maharashtra Akhadas & Wadas
milestones.summary: Folk traditions recorded gymnasiums (Talims and Akhadas) in Pune, Satara, and Baroda training youth in speed, breath control, and evasive tagging.
milestones.details: The game was played informally on uneven dust paths with stones marking the posts, developing lightning reflexes and team synchrony.
milestones.sourceName: Asian Kho Kho Federation Historical Archives

tracks.name: Documented Modern History
tracks.description: Chronologically verified milestones backed by federation archives, government gazettes, and official international tournament records.

milestones.headline: Deccan Gymkhana Drafts First Official Rules
milestones.summary: The Deccan Gymkhana sports club in Pune formed a dedicated committee to formalize rules, court markings, and competitive guidelines.
milestones.details: This marked the historic transition of Kho Kho from an unstandardized playground pastime to an organized, officiated field sport.

milestones.headline: Establishment of KKFI (Kho Kho Federation of India)
milestones.summary: The Kho Kho Federation of India was founded as the apex national governing body to unify regional associations across all states.
milestones.details: KKFI established standardized court specifications (27m x 16m), national referee certification, and inter-state championship structures.
milestones.sourceName: Kho Kho Federation of India Official Portal

milestones.headline: First National Kho Kho Championship in Vijayawada
milestones.summary: The inaugural Men's National Championship was hosted at Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, sparking statewide collegiate and club circuits.
milestones.details: The women's national championship followed immediately in 1960–61 at Kolhapur, Maharashtra, institutionalizing women's participation.

milestones.headline: Sudhir Parab Wins Inaugural Arjuna Award
milestones.summary: Legendary chaser Sudhir Parab became the very first sportsperson to receive India's prestigious Arjuna Award for excellence in Kho Kho.
milestones.details: This conferred national civilian sporting honors upon traditional Indian sports, inspiring thousands of young rural and university athletes.
milestones.sourceName: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Govt of India

milestones.headline: Asian Games Demonstration in New Delhi
milestones.summary: Kho Kho was featured as an official demonstration sport during the IX Asian Games held in New Delhi, captivating international delegates.
milestones.details: This led to the formation of the Asian Kho Kho Federation (AKKF) in 1987 and the 1st Asian Championship in Kolkata.
milestones.sourceName: Asian Kho Kho Federation Official Records

milestones.headline: Ultimate Kho Kho (UKK) Franchise Revolution
milestones.summary: Season 1 of Ultimate Kho Kho debuted on prime-time television with 6 franchises, supercharged rules ('Wazir', 'Sky Dive'), and 164M viewers.
milestones.details: Odisha Juggernauts clinched the thrilling inaugural title 46–45 against Telugu Yoddhas at Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex, Pune.
milestones.sourceName: Ultimate Kho Kho League Official Release

milestones.headline: Inaugural Kho Kho World Cup in New Delhi
milestones.summary: 24 nations competed at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi (Jan 13–19, 2025). India won double gold in Men's and Women's divisions.
milestones.details: Men defeated Nepal 54–36, and Women defeated Nepal 78–40 in front of capacity crowds, propelling Kho Kho toward future Olympic recognition.
